en.text:
Powered Melee Kills and Finishers grant <void/>Invisibility and restore 67 HP. 

Invisibility Duration is based on <link Enemy Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />:
• Minors: 7 seconds
• Elites, Enemy Players: 10 seconds 
• Minibosses and Bosses: 13 seconds

The duration of <void/>Invisibility granted by Finishers is 3 seconds longer. <void/>Echo of Persistence increases <void/>Invisibility duration by 41.5%.
